candidates.venue: Woodmere Art Museum, 9201 Germantown Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19118
candidates.description:
(1936, 87 min)
Charlie Chaplin’s final outing as the Little Tramp is a thoughtful and delightful critique of life in an increasingly mechanized world. From factory assembly lines to prison and unemployment, Chaplin blends physical comedy, romance, and social satire in a film that is perhaps more meaningful today than ever. Paulette Goddard co-stars as a spirited street urchin. “Modern Times” was one of the first 25 films selected by the Library of Congress for preservation in the National Film Registry for being " culturally, historically, or aesthetically significant".
